scope: Local adapter-node revision; no production deployment or live YouTube control test
cta: Moderaty free dry run link reaches the existing homepage FAQ; no sign-in or moderation action performed

author_and_metadata.canonical: Configured site origin plus established owning route

source_text_match.additional_web_elements: Accessible table caption, byline bio link, and two H3 subsection labels preserving old fragment destinations

regression_proof.test: src/routes/blogs/contents.test.ts: preserved H3 deep links have a scroll offset larger than the fixed navigation
regression_proof.before: Failed: compiled CSS provided no H3 scroll offset.
regression_proof.after: Passed: 96px H3 offset exceeds the 64px navigation; browser checks place both preserved targets below the navigation at all five widths.

visual_review.result: No content clipping, page overflow or broken table observed.

keyboard_check: At 320px, the focused table region scrolls horizontally with ArrowRight; mobile contents collapses after following a link.
browser_runtime: Chromium 141 through Playwright; standalone verification tooling only, no project dependencies changed. Test font configuration pointed to existing local fonts.
database_scope: Only a disposable local SQLite file was used. Article/index rendering is independent of its database. Homepage FAQ was reachable; its database guard logged empty-fixture warnings. No authenticated or database-backed workflow was tested.
live_youtube_control_test: Not performed; factual instructions were checked against current official documentation.
